source2='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = {}
    for row in grid:
        for v in row:
            counts[v] = counts.get(v, 0) + 1
    bg = max(counts, key=counts.get)
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == bg:
                continue
            for dr, dc in ((1, 1), (1, -1)):
                if not (0 <= r + dr < h and 0 <= c + dc < w and grid[r + dr][c + dc] == color):
                    continue
                # Find the endpoints of this same-color diagonal run.
                sr, sc = r, c
                while 0 <= sr - dr < h and 0 <= sc - dc < w and grid[sr - dr][sc - dc] == color:
                    sr -= dr
                    sc -= dc
                er, ec = r + dr, c + dc
                while 0 <= er + dr < h and 0 <= ec + dc < w and grid[er + dr][ec + dc] == color:
                    er += dr
                    ec += dc
                for ar, ac, adr, adc in ((sr, sc, -dr, -dc), (er, ec, dr, dc)):
                    nr, nc = ar + adr, ac + adc
                    while 0 <= nr < h and 0 <= nc < w and grid[nr][nc] == bg:
                        out[nr][nc] = color
                        nr += adr
                        nc += adc
    return out
'''

source3='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = {}
    for row in grid:
        for v in row:
            counts[v] = counts.get(v, 0) + 1
    bg = max(counts, key=counts.get)
    groups = {}
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        for c, v in enumerate(row):
            if v != bg:
                groups.setdefault(v, []).append((r, c))
    points = [p for ps in groups.values() for p in ps]
    cr = sum(r for r, c in points) / len(points)
    cc = sum(c for r, c in points) / len(points)
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for color, ps in groups.items():
        # Only extend a color that contains a diagonally adjacent same-color pair.
        pairs = [(a, b) for i, a in enumerate(ps) for b in ps[i+1:]
                 if abs(a[0]-b[0]) == 1 and abs(a[1]-b[1]) == 1]
        if not pairs:
            continue
        pr = sum(r for r, c in ps) / len(ps)
        pc = sum(c for r, c in ps) / len(ps)
        dr = 1 if pr > cr else -1
        dc = 1 if pc > cc else -1
        for r, c in ps:
            nr, nc = r + dr, c + dc
            while 0 <= nr < h and 0 <= nc < w and grid[nr][nc] == bg:
                out[nr][nc] = color
                nr += dr
